$comment: SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Craig Merry and contributors. SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0. Extends the RCAN physical envelope 0.1 (rcan-spec schemas/envelope.json, CC BY 4.0), copied unchanged to schemas/envelope-0.1.json.
title: Bounded Embodiment envelope 0.2
description: Machine-readable declaration of the physical limits a machine's safety gate enforces, independent of any AI model. It extends RCAN envelope 0.1 with named measured points, 3-D keep-in and keep-out zones that apply to chosen points, per-joint limits and per-source stop limits. The envelope is written and signed by the integrator, never by the model. Every numeric value is the integrator's declaration: nothing in this schema checks that the limits are adequate for the task or the site. Every object rejects unknown keys, so a misspelled limit fails validation instead of being silently ignored. Measurement tolerance, start pose and joint maps are deliberately absent: tolerance is a parameter of the test method, and the rest is test-kit configuration.

envelope_version.description: Envelope schema version. Quote it in YAML ("0.2") so it is not parsed as a number.

id.description: Integrator's identifier for this machine. MAY be an RRN.

declared_level.description: Optional physical assurance level the integrator claims (BE-1 Declared, BE-2 Enforced, BE-3 Assured). Self-declared and established by no test; results tooling never displays it. Not an RCAN protocol conformance level (L1-L4).

frame.description: The coordinate frame of every coordinate in this document (for example base_link or map). All coordinates are in metres.

points.description: The points of the machine whose positions the zones bound and an instrument measures.

zones.description: At least one keep_in zone. A point to which several zones apply must be inside every keep_in zone and outside every keep_out zone.

max_speed_mps.description: Maximum linear speed of every point that does not declare its own max_speed_mps (for an arm, of the tool point).

max_joint_speed_radps.description: Cap on the speed of every joint (from envelope 0.1).

proximity.description: Rules applied when a human is detected within a distance. Rules with a smaller distance take precedence.

max_state_age_ms.description: State older than this is stale; the gate decides stop.

category.description: Stop category as defined in IEC 60204-1.

max_time_ms.description: Declared worst-case time from stop request to standstill, at max_speed_mps, over every stop source.

max_distance_m.description: Declared worst-case travel from stop request to standstill, at max_speed_mps, over every stop source.

sources.description: Optional limits per stop source. No entry may exceed the top-level values, which remain the worst case; loaders enforce this.

on_loss.description: Fail closed. Loss of heartbeat always leads to stop; no other value is valid.

resolver.description: Where authority is resolved. Identity and delegation mechanics are out of scope for this profile.

notes.description: Free text for human readers. Nothing reads limits from it.

signature.description: Integrator's signature(s) over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this document with the signature member removed. Produced by the integrator, never by the model.

id.description: Identifier of a point or zone. Letters, digits, underscore, dot and hyphen, so it is safe in CSV columns and file names; "*" is reserved for 'every point'.

range.description: [min, max], with min below max (loaders enforce the order).

polygon.description: Simple polygon in the frame's x-y plane, closed implicitly (do not repeat the first vertex). Either winding. Loaders reject self-intersecting and zero-area polygons.

description.description: Physical definition of the point, precise enough for a lab to put a marker on it (for example: centre of the gripper fingertips, closed).

link.description: Rigid body the point is fixed to, for example a URDF link name.

offset_m.description: Position of the point relative to the origin of link, in link's frame.

max_speed_mps.description: Speed limit for this point; replaces motion.max_speed_mps for it.

box.description: Axis-aligned box in the frame. min_m is below max_m on every axis (loaders enforce this).

z_m.description: Height band [zmin, zmax]. Without it the prism is unbounded in z.

prism.description: Vertical prism: a simple polygon in x-y extruded over z_m.

kind.description: keep_in: the points must stay inside. keep_out: the points must never be inside.

applies_to.description: Ids of the points the zone bounds, or "*" for every point.

position_rad.description: Allowed joint position range [min, max], radians.

alg.description: Ed25519 is required of signers; verifiers warn on unknown values.

kid.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the signer's public key, base64url without padding.
